rule.description: Interim (provisional, from a partial load-sensitivity study): the measuring core is isolated from the measured process's other threads; the measuring thread ran at least 99% of its frame time at the median and 97% at the 5th percentile; the measuring processor's sibling was at most 10% busy, whoever's work it was, and its own processor at most 10% busy with other work; other processes kept at most a quarter of the logical processors busy (at least one) and the measured GPU's busiest engine at most 15% busy; and within a session the four runs' other-process load differed by at most 2 logical processors.

admission.samplingPass: judged on every indicator but the running share, which the sampler lowers by design
admission.presentPass: judged on other processes' load from the host observer: the window host's thread is not pinned and records no interference
admission.coreIsolation: every embedded pass pins its measuring thread with the isolating form (FrameTiming::PinMeasuringThread); cases[].admission[].indicators carry isolated and isolationError
admission.sessionSpread: the rule's within-session spread applies to A/B/B/A sessions of the frame timing method; an attribution pass is one run and has none
